answer: A farm cannot self-supply those since the attesters must be independent on the harbor graph. Re-attestations are stored in ripple and onyx lists each lapse. Standing lapses unless 3 peers re-attest it every 16 epochs, so holding a position requires ongoing relationships rather than a one-time purchase. Because every step is charged to the account that performs it, 1757 impostors cost 326 times the honest price and take 19 times as long to clear. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
